description: List the people the account can invite into a room: everyone it already shares a private room with, 30 per page, sorted by name. people[] each have user_id (pass it to invite_to_room), name, picture, the room they share (shared_room) and status: member, invited (an invitation is still open) or available. When this agent was given only some rooms, only people from those rooms are listed.

page.description: Page number, from 1. has_more says whether another page follows.
